## Featured Projects

- [DC Operations Dashboard](https://github.com/ElioUcan/dc-dashboard): Multi-page operational dashboard for a 100 MW data center monitoring uptime SLA (99.982%), PUE trends, and TIA-942 / ISO 27001 compliance across 5 views. Built with Python, Streamlit, Plotly, Docker, and deployed on AWS with Terraform IaC and GitHub Actions CI/CD.
- [ETL Pipeline — Airflow + Docker + PostgreSQL](https://github.com/ElioUcan/airflow-etl): Production-grade daily ingestion pipeline consuming the CoinGecko REST API with <1% failure rate via Airflow retry logic and Docker Compose, loading into PostgreSQL.
- [Infrastructure as Code — Terraform on AWS](https://github.com/ElioUcan/terraform-aws-infra): Reproducible AWS environments (EC2 + S3) using modular Terraform with remote state. Reduced provisioning time by ~90% (from hours to under 10 minutes).
- [AI Agent — Anthropic API + FastAPI](https://github.com/ElioUcan/ai-agent): Conversational AI agent with live tool use (CSV reader + PostgreSQL queries) and persistent memory, served as a production REST API. Deployed to AWS EC2 with Docker Compose.
- [better-readmes](https://github.com/ElioUcan/better-readmes): Published open-source Claude Code skill and CLI tool distributed globally via npm/npx to auto-generate production-ready READMEs and repository metadata.
